# ScribeCat 0.24.7

- The embedded **Combined view** PDF window now follows the actual PDF page aspect ratio.
- Narrowing the Markdown document column now also reduces the PDF window height, removing the large empty area below landscape pages.
- Existing PDF page navigation, text selection, touch swipe, copy, and split-view behavior are unchanged.

Compare: v0.24.6...v0.24.7
